bugs.anchor: # FSDP2 requires uniform orig_dtype among trainable params in each group.
bugs.summary: The upcast to fp32 is now done after `original_sd = model.state_dict()` was captured earlier in fsdp2_prepare_model. original_sd therefore holds bf16/fp16 tensors while the sharded params are fp32.
bugs.trigger: Use mixed_precision != "no" with cpu_ram_efficient_loading=True on a model with bf16/fp16 trainable params. In fsdp2_load_full_state_dict, rank 0 broadcasts a bf16/fp16 tensor from original_sd. Other ranks allocate fp32 buffers, so the element sizes differ and dist.broadcast deadlocks, hanging training.
